hallucination.reason: Agent stayed within the approved knowledge base and did not invent any facts or details.

overclaim.reason: Agent did not guarantee or promise anything that must remain indicative or subject to verification.

interruption_recovery.reason: The conversation remained on track without interruptions, aggression, or derailment.

obedience.reason: Agent stayed within its actual role and knowledge base, without inventing services, comparisons, or opinions not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: Agent correctly offered to escalate and transfer the caller to the loan processing team for out-of-scope requests.
